adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `next`/`previous` actions compute a new `offset`, immediately `group.set("offset", offset)`, and then call `group.findMembers()`. Since `currentPage/showingFirst/showingLast` are computed from `offset/limit/user_count`, a failed `findMembers()` request would leave pagination state pointing at the new page while `members` was never updated (still showing the old page). Also, there is no loading/in-flight guard, so repeated rapid `next/previous` clicks can trigger multiple concurrent `findMembers()` calls and whichever resolves last will win, potentially displaying members inconsistent with the latest `offset` the user selected.
